slot.brief: Order given radicals or carbocations by stability, possibly including benzylic/allylic vs alkyl, and pick the correct decreasing-stability sequence.

stem: Arrange the following free radicals in decreasing order of stability: $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{C}^\bullet$, $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CH}^\bullet$, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2^\bullet$ and $\text{CH}_3^\bullet$.

verdicts.working: Alkyl radical stability increases with substitution due to hyperconjugation: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl. This matches (A).

working:

$3^\circ > 2^\circ > 1^\circ > \text{methyl}$
